title: Varicocele surgery
what: The surgeon ties off the enlarged veins leading to the testicle. Blood then drains through healthy veins.
why: For a varicocele with pain, a shrinking testicle, or problems on a semen analysis.
duration: surgery usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; you usually go home the same day or the next
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will say what to do
Heart or lung disease, or diabetes

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, a scrotal ultrasound, sometimes a semen analysis. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthesia
prepare.text: It may be local or general. With general anesthesia, an anesthetist will talk with you.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: With general anesthesia, usually no food from the night before and no drinks for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

steps: You change, and an IV line is placed
The surgeon makes a small cut in the groin or small punctures in the belly
The enlarged veins are found and tied off
You rest in the ward after surgery
feel: Pain at the cut. You will get painkillers
after: You can usually walk the same day
No heavy lifting or sports for a few weeks. Your doctor will say how long
A repeat semen analysis is usually done after a few months
red_flags: Severe swelling of the scrotum that keeps growing
Pus or redness at the stitches

faq.q: Will my semen analysis improve after surgery?
faq.a: It often improves, but not for everyone. The result is usually checked after 3 to 6 months.
Sometimes. That is why your doctor schedules follow-up visits.

reminders.text: Surgery tomorrow. Pack your documents, test results, and snug underwear. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
